case_title.quote: PATTU RAJAN v. THE STATE OF TAMIL NADU
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment refers to Accused No. 9 and the value says 8; the accused count is at least nine.

accused_gender.quote: Accused No.1 wanted to marry her and how he often tried to lure her
accused_gender.reason: Accused are referred to with male pronouns, consistent with 'Male'.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.quote: Accused No. 1 is the proprietor of a chain of hotels
accused_occupation.reason: Directly stated in the facts section.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not explicitly stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: PW1 and her husband were abducted
victim_gender.reason: Victim is the husband of PW1; male.

victim_age.correct_value: Approximately 30 years (per PW29's description of the body)
victim_age.quote: saw the dead body of a male aged about 30 years
victim_age.reason: Judgment records the body as aged about 30 years, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: No family relation; accused wanted to marry the victim's wife (PW1)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: wanted to take PW1 as his third wife
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused No.1 was not the victim's spouse; he sought to marry the victim's wife.

offence_category.quote: the abduction and murder of one Santhakumar
offence_category.reason: Murder is the central offence in these appeals.

statutory_provisions.quote: Charges were framed under various provisions of the Indian Penal Code ... Sections 302, 364 and 201
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 302, 364, 304 Part I and 201 IPC all appear in the judgment.

weapon.correct_value: Strangulation (throttling) with a lungi; accused Nos. 3 and 4 were armed with knives
weapon.quote: strangulation of the said person by using materials like a lungi
weapon.reason: Judgment describes strangulation with a lungi and knives carried by accused, not 'None mentioned'.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial, medical (post-mortem), recovery, last seen, handwriting and superimposition/expert evidence
evidence_type.quote: the whole case rests on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Dying declaration is not mentioned; other listed types are supported but expert and handwriting evidence are omitted.

confession.correct_value: Confession of accused No.2 (s.27 recovery of body); confession of accused No.6 (recovery of wallet and gold chain)
confession.quote: Based on the confession of Accused No.6, recoveries of a wallet
confession.reason: Accused No.2's confession leading to the body recovery is omitted; only No.6 is listed.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not separately discuss aggravating circumstances; 'None noted' is consistent with that.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not discuss mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted the accused appellants for the offences punishable under Sections 364, 304 Part I and 201 of the IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court conviction described.

high_court_outcome.quote: modified the conviction for the offence punishable under Section 304 Part I to Section 302 of the IPC
high_court_outcome.reason: Matches the High Court modification described.

final_outcome.quote: Hence these appeals fail and stand dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, so the convictions stand.

offence_finally_established.quote: modified the conviction for the offence punishable under Section 304 Part I to Section 302 of the IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 is the finally upheld offence.

imprisonment_type.reason: Judgment does not state any sentence or sentence type.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of imprisonment appears in the judgment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is stated in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral summary of facts without the court's findings, e.g. omit 'The accused were found to have...'
neutral_facts.quote: The accused were found to have taken the victim away in a car and murdered him
neutral_facts.reason: Summary states court findings of guilt, which the neutral facts field must not reveal.

offence_severity.correct_value: Section 302 (murder) as finally upheld; 364, 304 Part I and 201 at lower stages
offence_severity.quote: modified the conviction for the offence punishable under Section 304 Part I to Section 302
offence_severity.reason: Final severity is s.302; '302/304 Part-I' suggests an unresolved split that the judgment does not leave open.

attempt_completion.quote: committed his murder and threw away his body at the Tiger-Chola forest area
attempt_completion.reason: Murder was carried out and the body disposed of.

physical_harm.quote: the cause of death was found to be asphyxia due to throttling
physical_harm.reason: Death of the victim is established.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Multiple: ss.302, 364 and 201 IPC charged; convicted under ss.364, 302 (modified from 304 Part I) and 201
number_of_offences.quote: Charges were framed under various provisions of the Indian Penal Code
number_of_offences.reason: Three offences were charged and convictions under three sections were recorded, not 'two charged, one upheld'.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Rs 5 lakhs allegedly given to accused No.2 to kill the deceased; no direct property loss stated
financial_property_loss.quote: being given Rs. 5 lakhs by Accused No.1 to kill him
financial_property_loss.reason: 'Not applicable' overlooks the alleged Rs 5 lakh payment to kill the deceased.

premeditation_planning.quote: Ultimately, Accused No.1 committed the offence in question in order to eliminate the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Judgment describes planned elimination of the deceased to marry PW1.

motive.quote: Accused No.1 wanted to take PW1 as his third wife despite knowing that she was already married
motive.reason: Motive to marry PW1 by eliminating her husband is stated.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence of PWs 1 and 2 with regard to the motive for commission of the offence, the last seen circumstance and recovery
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the court's stated acceptance of PW1 and PW2 evidence and superimposition.

witness_credibility.quote: Though PW1 was cross-examined at length, the defence could not discredit her evidence on material particulars
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the court's assessment of PW1, PW2 and PW7.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused surrendered and confessed; accused No.2 gave a false story; accused No.1 had PW1 undergo rituals
post_offence_conduct.quote: the accused had surrendered and confessed to the commission of Santhakumar's murder
post_offence_conduct.reason: Surrender, confession and related conduct are stated, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

trial_duration.correct_value: Not stated (High Court judgment dated 19.03.2009; Supreme Court decided 29.03.2019)
trial_duration.quote: The judgment dated 19.03.2009 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 637 and 748 of 2004
trial_duration.reason: 19.03.2009 is the High Court date, not the trial judgment date; trial date is not given.

legal_representation.correct_value: Accused: Shri Sushil Kumar, Sr. Adv. (for appellants); State: Shri Balaji Srinivasan, AAG
legal_representation.quote: Shri Balaji Srinivasan, the learned Additional Advocate General appearing on behalf of the State
legal_representation.reason: Balaji Srinivasan appeared for the State, not the accused, and State counsel is stated.

investigation_status.quote: The separate first information lodged in this case is just, legal and proper
investigation_status.reason: Separate FIR for murder, charges framed and trial conducted are supported; chargesheet is implied.

procedural_irregularity.quote: we cannot accept the contention that the same has been used as a substantive piece of evidence
procedural_irregularity.reason: Irregularities were argued but rejected; 'None noted' reflects the court's findings.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted under ss.364, 304 Part I, 201; High Court modified s.304 Part I to s.302 and upheld; Supreme Court dismissed appeals
appeal_history.quote: the High Court while confirming the finding of guilt of the accused, modified the conviction
appeal_history.reason: Modification was by the High Court on appeal, not by the trial court as labelled.

prosecution_argument.quote: Accused No.1 wanted to take PW1 as his third wife
prosecution_argument.reason: Summary matches the prosecution case of motive and the supporting evidence.

defence_argument.correct_value: Murder was a continuation of the abduction; second FIR impermissible; Ext P3 wrongly used; last seen not put under s.313; recovery shaky; motive unproven; DNA absence fatal
defence_argument.quote: the first information in the present case (Ext. P1) registered on 20.11.2001 could not have been registered at all
defence_argument.reason: Omits several defence grounds, including the second FIR, Ext P3, s.313 and motive challenges; 'same investigation' is imprecise.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the Court is not bound by the evidence of the experts
legal_principle_applied.reason: Circumstantial evidence and advisory nature of expert opinion are both applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All cases the judgment relies on are listed.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Sentencing is not discussed; 'Not applicable' reflects this.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are discussed by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are discussed by the court.

other_sentence_order.quote: Thus, the judgment of the Trial Court as modified by the High Court need not be interfered with.
other_sentence_order.reason: No additional sentence orders are stated; the judgment only dismisses the appeals.
